data.narrative:
Foundry Robotics is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Adarsh Kulkarni that has raised $19M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 9 private peers and 1 public company in the robotics and manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach, using the $19M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage progression. This yields an implied valuation of $48M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient narrow-stage comparable data; while 10 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 met same-stage or adjacent-stage filters, making sector-wide medians potentially misleading and therefore excluded from triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $55M, with a median of $48M. However, this range rests on a single applicable method, introducing material uncertainty. Validation would benefit from deeper analysis of the public comparable (277810.KQ) and closer examination of the broader private peer set to establish whether adjacent-stage or tier-based comparables could strengthen the triangulation. Key unknowns include runway burn, revenue traction if any, and competitive positioning relative to the identified peer set.
